caveat: Simulated subject, simulated injections, linear surrogate decoder. Recovery means the sentence named the injected muscle group and direction; it is not evidence that the sentence helps a person. No timing advice: the simulator has no onset envelope. The back-projection inverts the same family of volume-conduction model the simulator generates from; only the electrode rotation and conduction length differ. Recorded anatomy will not be this kind, so this is an upper bound on localisation, not an estimate of it.
